front: Gain a +1 status bonus to Recall Knowledge with a chosen skill by pulling a tome from an extradimensional library. Ends after you use it.
back:
On cast, choose a skill you're trained in that has Recall Knowledge. Calling forth the tome is part of the Recall Knowledge action; you need a free hand.
+1 status bonus to the check. A critical failure becomes a failure. On a success about a creature, gain extra information.
Spell ends after one use.
Heightened (3rd): +2, two uses.
Heightened (6th): +3, three uses.
Heightened (9th): +4, four uses.
